motivation.prior_finding: WSP-208 synthetic B0 witness MSE after B3 candidate 1.000 vs full-refit rank4 0.0629285; candidate B0 prediction drift near zero vs control 0.5612; held scores roughly zero-readout. Synthetic dev only.
motivation.question: Did contradiction-gated direct writes suppress useful cumulative learning, or did both methods lack identifiable information under lambda10?
motivation.rule: Never reinterpret WSP-200; report new source-free diagnosis, preserve all negatives.

cohort.identity: Independent synthetic-only generated worlds; prefix FABRICATED_WSP209; exact synthetic digest f repeated 64; no original GFP.
cohort.generator: Deterministic latent rank4 coordinates from sin/cos(seed, site, alternate); target=dot of two coordinate vectors. Hub graph: sites1..72 with pairs(1,j), plus bridge pairs(j,j+1) for even j=2..70. Complete graph: sites1..18 all unordered pairs. Two synthetic double alleles C/C and D/D for each site pair, A as native source. No protected measured labels.
cohort.split: Frozen WSP200 salted SHA256 whole-site-pair FIT[0..64], VALID[65..79], PUBLIC_DEV[80..89], RESERVED_UNTOUCHED[90..99]; FIT stage 0..3 from frozen SHA256 stream.
cohort.limits: <=5000 generated doubles across 4 worlds; one independent evaluation per world; never access RESERVED values, no original-data first use.
cohort.independence: Four constructed worlds are NOT independent biological replicates or evidence of general intelligence.

protocol.parity: Identical FIT and future-label boundaries, same cumulative B0..B3 observation sets, rank4, lambda10, hash init and B0 scaling; no post-label adjustments.
protocol.outcomes: Per-world per-arm B0 witness MSE at stage0,1,2,3; B0 drift; writes/solves; held PUBLIC_DEV group-equal RMSE and zero readout; warm full-refit convergence, exact cold restore, CPU/wall and checkpoint bytes.

classification.UPDATE_SUPPRESSION: At least 3/4 worlds: full_refit B0 error improves >=20% from stage0 to B3; contradiction improves <5%; contradiction B1..B3 address writes <=10% of always.
classification.INFORMATION_LIMIT: At least 3/4 worlds: both full_refit and contradiction improve <20% from stage0 to B3.
classification.CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED_DEV: At least 3/4 worlds contradiction improves >=20% from stage0 to B3 and B3 B0 MSE <=1.05 * full_refit and held RMSE <=1.02 * full_refit (timing separate). Source-free development only.
classification.MIXED: Other valid outcomes, no forced positive narrative.
classification.INVALID: Missing B0/held, nonfinite values, source hash/identity mismatch, any held-leak, nonconverged full-refit control, incomplete or failed CI, unexpected genotype partition overlap.

protocol.compute: Python 3.12 stdlib only, max20m per CI OS, no paid APIs, private runners, network, new controllers or queues.
protocol.stop: One frozen four-world diagnostic. Do not tune or rerun new seeds after seeing outcome; record negative. A revised mechanism requires another distinct pre-results protocol.
